records.title: Bitquery — Binance Hack: USD6.3B drained on nine chains; 233.5M XRP receiver balance observed at 06:43 UTC
records.note: Bitquery says 17 Binance proof-of-reserves-labelled hot wallets across nine chains sent approximately USD6.3B between 20:04 and 23:56 UTC on 2026-10-29; approximately USD2.7B was frozen/rescued and approximately USD3.2B remained with the attacker at 06:43 UTC. The XRPL was first: five Binance-labelled accounts sent approximately 233.5M XRP to a new account. At 06:43 UTC the XRP receiver held approximately 233.5M XRP and had never sent a transaction. Bitquery says the XRP and Solana receivers share no address with the other cross-chain clusters; association is based on timing, unusual transaction construction and Binance's aggregate loss. Address labels may be incomplete or incorrect. Its nine-chain scope differs from other investigators' ten-chain scope. This is a time-bounded provider observation, not proof of current post-06:43 balance or sale.
